name: share-sheet-carousel-landscape
title: Share-Sheet Carousel (landscape)
description: An iOS share sheet springs up over its blurred ground and cuts through four previews on a fast rhythm, then the accept tap. Words, images and beat times are variables; holds to the end of the mount.
author: Miao Yang

variables.description: Heading at the top of the share sheet.

variables.label: Sender
variables.description: Name of the brand this video promotes, shown as the sender offering the item. Use the real name of that brand.

variables.label: Item
variables.description: What the sender is offering, completing the sentence "… would like to share …".

variables.label: Brand strip
variables.description: Positioning line of the brand this video promotes, in small caps beside its logo.
